placeorder_rules.reading: PlaceOrder: 10 typestates over 10 checker nodes, lookahead 0; 11 rules (the start and one per typestate: in it each next typestate is possible and nothing else is). Faithfulness is decided as one bisimulation check: pass faithful a task or lean to compare a model with this protocol. Every message name labels one typestate, so the name alone is the state: no hidden state.

retry_rules.reading: Retry: 9 typestates over 11 checker nodes, lookahead 4; 10 rules (the start and one per typestate: in it each next typestate is possible and nothing else is). Faithfulness is decided as one bisimulation check: pass faithful a task or lean to compare a model with this protocol. Hidden state: Ask labels 3 typestates and needs 2 bits, Busy labels 3 typestates and needs 2 bits; a message must carry them (in a field, or by cause or prev) or every participant must remember them.
